4X absorption. Reduces melanin at the cellular source. Not just on the surface.

N-Acetyl Cysteine
NAC · Glutathione Precursor

Your body's own glutathione factory. Repairs what acne left behind.

NAC is the direct precursor your body uses to produce its own glutathione internally. While LumiThione™ delivers external glutathione, NAC replenishes internal production — creating a compounding double-dose effect. It also supports liver detoxification, reducing the systemic oxidative load that manifests as skin inflammation and breakouts. Clinical studies confirm NAC's role in reducing post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation — the dark marks acne leaves behind.

Frequently asked

Why does liposomal glutathione work better than regular glutathione?+

Regular glutathione is broken down by stomach acid and digestive enzymes before it reaches your bloodstream — studies show very little survives digestion intact. LumiThione™ encapsulates glutathione in a phospholipid liposomal shell (the same material your cell walls are made from), which survives stomach acid and releases glutathione directly into the blood at full potency. The result: up to 4X more glutathione reaches your skin cells.

When will I see results?+

Most customers notice the first visible change — skin looking less dull, more awake — between weeks 3 and 4. Significant reduction in pigmentation and acne marks typically appears between weeks 6 and 8. Full clinical results — even tone, lightened dark spots, noticeably brighter complexion — appear at weeks 8–12. Results compound: every day builds on the day before. After 12 weeks, switch to 1 capsule daily to maintain.

Can I take both capsules at the same time?+

Yes — completely safe. Two capsules after the same meal is fine if that suits your routine. For optimal coverage, one in the morning and one in the evening allows the 12-hour sustained release to provide continuous glutathione support through the full day. But both at breakfast or both at dinner both work.

Which pack size should I choose?+

For first-timers: the 30-capsule pack (₹1,614) — a 15-day full-dose trial. For the best value and complete 8-week clinical window: the 60-capsule pack (₹2,831) — our most popular. For the full 12-week transformation protocol where peak results appear: the 120-capsule pack (₹5,334).

Are there any side effects?+

Skin Brilliance has no known side effects. All six actives are classified as dietary supplements within ICMR RDA guidelines. The formula is FSSAI approved and manufactured in a US FDA certified facility. Third-party lab tested for heavy metals every batch. As with any supplement, consult your physician before use if you are pregnant, nursing, or have a chronic medical condition.
